tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder mobile in ZIP 94587 on phone, just pull up DOGS only — nothing else for now. Someone scrolling on the bus only wants to see dogs in the listing. Use the slide-up filter drawer with species checkboxes and 'Good With' pills so only the Dog species checkbox is on and no compatibility tags are set.

Quick question — on Petfinder mobile, how many CAT listings are showing in the current catalog (don't apply any filters, just the raw cat count from the slide-up filter drawer with species checkboxes and 'Good With' pills)? Just the integer.

On Petfinder mobile, narrow to RABBITS and make sure the 'Good with no children' compatibility tag is on too — someone scrolling on the bus is helping a single retiree neighbour. Use the slide-up filter drawer with species checkboxes and 'Good With' pills: the species side must be Rabbit, and compatibility must include 'Good with no children'.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Rabbit]; filter_state: compat=[Good with no children]

tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder mobile, someone scrolling on the bus already has a chocolate lab and a 4-year-old. Pull up either a dog OR a cat (no rabbits no birds — species side: both Dog and Cat checked), and on the compatibility side require BOTH 'Good with kids' AND 'Good with dogs'. Use the slide-up filter drawer with species checkboxes and 'Good With' pills; don't filter sex or breed.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Dog]; filter_state: species=[Cat]; filter_state: compat=[Good with kids]; filter_state: compat=[Good with dogs]

tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder mobile, among the DOGS that carry BOTH the 'Good with kids' tag AND the 'Good with cats' tag in the slide-up filter drawer with species checkboxes and 'Good With' pills, which single dog has the highest adopter rating? Give me name + breed + rating.

On Petfinder mobile, how many RABBITS in the catalog are tagged 'Good with kids' on the compatibility side (this is the compatibility tag, NOT a separate 'kids' species — the slide-up filter drawer with species checkboxes and 'Good With' pills keeps those two axes separate), and which of those rabbits has the highest rating? Give count and the top rabbit's name + rating.

Carefully on Petfinder mobile: someone scrolling on the bus wants to see only CATS and RABBITS (both species, nothing else), and on the compatibility side BOTH 'Good with cats' AND 'Good with kids' must be on. Reason: senior resident cat + two elementary-age kids. Use the slide-up filter drawer with species checkboxes and 'Good With' pills — the trick is that 'cats' shows up in BOTH the species picker (Cat) AND the compatibility tags ('Good with cats'); make sure each is set on the correct axis.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Cat]; filter_state: species=[Rabbit]; filter_state: compat=[Good with cats]; filter_state: compat=[Good with kids]

tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder mobile, set up filters to show only BIRDS that are 'Good with kids' on the compatibility side — yes, the bird species filter is separate from the kids/dogs compatibility tags, don't confuse the two columns in the slide-up filter drawer with species checkboxes and 'Good With' pills. Then tell me which single bird has the highest rating, and what's its rating.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Bird]; filter_state: compat=[Good with kids]

tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder mobile, filter the catalog to DOGS and CATS (both species) that are tagged 'Good with cats' on the compatibility side — yes the 'Cat' species and the 'Good with cats' compatibility tag are TWO different controls in the slide-up filter drawer with species checkboxes and 'Good With' pills, both have to be set correctly. Then count how many of the matching pets are already spayed OR neutered.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Dog]; filter_state: species=[Cat]; filter_state: compat=[Good with cats]

tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder mobile, set the filters so the catalog shows DOGS and RABBITS (those two species) that ALSO carry the 'Good with kids' compatibility tag — remember in the slide-up filter drawer with species checkboxes and 'Good With' pills the species checkboxes are a different control from the compatibility tags. Then tell me which single listed pet has the highest rating, with name + breed + rating.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Dog]; filter_state: species=[Rabbit]; filter_state: compat=[Good with kids]
